name: Barabbas
summary: A well-known prisoner, a robber who had committed murder in an uprising. When Pilate offered to release one prisoner at the feast, the crowd asked for Barabbas instead of Jesus.

key_moments.title: Commits Murder in an Uprising
key_moments.description: Barabbas was a robber who lay bound in prison with others who had made an uprising with him. He had committed murder in the uprising in the city.

key_moments.title: Chosen by the Crowd Over Jesus
key_moments.description: At the feast Pilate would release one prisoner, and he asked the people whether they wanted Barabbas or Jesus. The chief priests and elders persuaded the crowd, and they cried out for Barabbas.

key_moments.title: Released Instead of Jesus
key_moments.description: Wanting to satisfy the people, Pilate let Barabbas go free. Then he had Jesus scourged and handed Him over to be crucified.
